label: ZAFFRE
credit: Overworld sprites by PurpleZaffre (Zaffre's Overworlds, from the Ultimate Gen 4 Overworlds Pack)
about: Pack: Ultimate Gen 4 Overworlds Pack; point the converter at its "Zaffre's Overworlds" folder. Only PurpleZaffre's own NPC_Z sheets are used. PurpleZaffre's sprites are free to use with credit; the pack itself isn't to be redistributed. So Facets ships only the converted sheets it uses (assets/npcs/zaffre/), credited, and this recipe rebuilds them. Fills the named characters no other set has: Hoenn's gym leaders, Wallace, Archie and Maxie, and Kanto's Agatha, Lorelei and Mr. Fuji.
